source_metadata.title: IMpower150 Final Exploratory Analyses for Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab and Chemotherapy in Key NSCLC Patient Subgroups With EGFR Mutations or Metastases in the Liver or Brain

atoms.canonical_statement: The final exploratory analysis evaluated overall survival in EGFR-mutation and baseline liver-metastasis subgroups and evaluated the rate and time to development of new brain metastases in IMpower150.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Final overall survival (OS) analyses are presented for EGFR mutations and liver or brain metastases subgroups in the phase 3 IMpower150 study.

atoms.canonical_statement: IMpower150 was an international, open-label, randomized phase 3 trial conducted at 240 study centers in 26 countries (NCT02366143).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: IMpower150 was an international, open-label, randomized, phase 3 trial conducted across 240 study centers in 26 countries (NCT02366143).

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligible patients had chemotherapy-naive stage IV metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC, measurable disease by RECIST 1.1, ECOG performance status 0 or 1, available tumor tissue for biomarker testing, and any PD-L1 immunohistochemistry status.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Chemotherapy-naive patients with stage IV metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC, measurable disease at baseline per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1, a baseline Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1, available tumor tissue for biomarker testing, and any PD-L1 immunohistochemistry status were eligible for inclusion.

population.label: Eligible IMpower150 population
inclusion_criteria: Chemotherapy-naive stage IV metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC
Available tumor tissue for biomarker testing

atoms.canonical_statement: Patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations or ALK translocations were required to have progression or intolerance after at least one approved TKI; untreated brain metastases were excluded, whereas treated stable brain metastases were permitted.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations ... or ALK translocations were required to have disease progression or treatment intolerance with at least one approved TKI therapy... Untreated brain metastases led to study exclusion.

population.label: Molecularly defined and brain-metastasis eligibility
inclusion_criteria: Prior progression or intolerance with at least one approved TKI for sensitizing EGFR mutation or ALK translocation

atoms.canonical_statement: ABCP consisted of intravenous atezolizumab 1200 mg, bevacizumab 15 mg/kg, carboplatin AUC 6 mg/mL per min, and paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 (175 mg/m2 for Asian patients) on day 1 of each 21-day cycle during four or six induction cycles.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Study treatments were administered intravenously on day 1 of each 21-day cycle at the following doses: atezolizumab 1200 mg, bevacizumab 15 mg/kg ... carboplatin ... 6 mg/mL per min ... and 200 mg/m2 paclitaxel (patients of Asian ethnicity were given 175 mg/m2).

atoms.canonical_statement: ACP used atezolizumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel without bevacizumab, with the same scheduled doses used for those agents in the study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients were randomized to ACP, ABCP, or BCP... Study treatments were administered intravenously on day 1 of each 21-day cycle at the following doses...

atoms.canonical_statement: BCP used bevacizumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel without atezolizumab, with the study-specified doses administered intravenously on day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients were randomized to ACP, ABCP, or BCP... Study treatments were administered intravenously on day 1 of each 21-day cycle at the following doses...

atoms.canonical_statement: Overall survival was defined as the time from randomization to death from any cause.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: OS was defined as the time from randomization to death from any cause.

outcome.definition: Time from randomization to death from any cause
outcome.measurement_method: Kaplan-Meier; hazard ratios from unstratified Cox regression

atoms.canonical_statement: Time to development of new brain metastases was defined as the time from randomization to observed newly developed brain lesions on brain scans.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Time to development of new brain metastases was defined as the time from randomization to the time of observed newly developed brain lesions in brain scans.

concept.text: Time to development of new brain metastases

outcome.definition: Time from randomization to observed newly developed brain lesions on brain scans
outcome.measurement_method: Kaplan-Meier; investigator-assessed brain CT or MRI as clinically indicated

atoms.canonical_statement: Median overall survival and time to new brain metastases were estimated by Kaplan-Meier methods; 95% confidence intervals for medians used Brookmeyer-Crowley, hazard ratios used unstratified Cox regression, and safety results were descriptive.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Median OS and time to development of new brain metastases in ITT patients were estimated from survival curves generated by the Kaplan-Meier method... Hazard ratios ... were calculated from unstratified Cox regression models... Safety results are presented descriptively.

atoms.canonical_statement: Supplementary Figure 1 reports 2166 patients assessed for eligibility, 964 screening failures, and 1202 randomized; 394 ABCP, 399 ACP, and 394 BCP participants received treatment.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 2166 assessed for eligibility; 964 patients failed screening; 1202 enrolled and randomized; 394 received treatment; 399 received treatment; 394 received treatment.

atoms.canonical_statement: The intention-to-treat population included 1202 randomized patients: 400 assigned to ABCP, 402 to ACP, and 400 to BCP; median follow-up at the September 13, 2019 cutoff was 39.3 months.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Overall, 1202 patients were enrolled in the ITT population... At data cutoff (September 13, 2019), the median duration of follow-up in the ITT population was 39.3 months.

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 123 patients with EGFR mutations, 34 were in ABCP, 45 in ACP, and 44 in BCP; 91 had sensitizing EGFR mutations, and 78 of those had received previous TKI therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Overall, 123 patients had EGFR mutations... A total of 123 patients had EGFR-mutated disease, including 91 whose tumors had a sensitizing mutation... 78 had received previous TKI therapy.

atoms.canonical_statement: The baseline liver-metastasis subgroup included 161 patients: 52 in ABCP, 52 in ACP, and 57 in BCP.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A total of 161 patients had baseline liver metastases: 52 patients each in the ABCP and ACP arms and 57 patients in the BCP arm.

atoms.canonical_statement: In patients with EGFR mutations, median OS was 26.1 months with ABCP versus 20.3 months with BCP (HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.53-1.59).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In patients with EGFR mutations, median OS was 26.1 months in the ABCP arm and 20.3 months in the BCP arm; the HR point estimate ... was 0.91 (95% CI: 0.53–1.59).

outcome.definition: Time from randomization to death from any cause
outcome.measurement_method: Kaplan-Meier; hazard ratios from unstratified Cox regression

quantitative_result.original_result_text: Median OS 26.1 vs 20.3 months; HR 0.91 (95% CI 0.53-1.59).

atoms.canonical_statement: In patients with EGFR mutations, median OS was 21.4 months with ACP versus 20.3 months with BCP (HR 1.16, 95% CI 0.71-1.89).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: OS improvement was not found in the ACP arm versus the BCP arm (median = 21.4 versus 20.3 mo, HR = 1.16, 95% CI: 0.71–1.89).

outcome.definition: Time from randomization to death from any cause
outcome.measurement_method: Kaplan-Meier; hazard ratios from unstratified Cox regression

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations, median OS was longer in the ABCP arm (29.4 mo) than in the BCP arm (18.1 mo) (HR = 0.60, 95% CI: 0.31–1.14).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Median OS was similar between the ACP (19.0 mo) and BCP (18.1 mo) arms (HR = 1.00, 95% CI: 0.57–1.74).

atoms.canonical_statement: The subgroup analyses had small sample sizes and were exploratory; although prespecified, they did not allow formal statistical testing, so the findings should be interpreted with caution.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Small sample sizes between subgroups and the exploratory nature of the subanalyses, although prespecified, did not allow for formal statistical testing. Therefore, the current findings should be interpreted with caution.

atoms.canonical_statement: The brain-metastasis analyses were post hoc and brain imaging was performed as clinically indicated rather than by routine scheduled assessment, limiting inference about delayed development of new brain lesions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Brain scans ... were performed as clinically indicated... Analyses of the rate and time to development of new brain metastases were post hoc analyses.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that final exploratory analyses suggested OS benefit for ABCP versus BCP in patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations, including prior TKI failure, and in patients with liver metastases, while emphasizing cautious interpretation and the need for further study of delayed brain-lesion development.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This final exploratory analysis revealed OS benefits for ABCP versus BCP in patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations, including those with previous TKI failures, and with liver metastases, although these results should be interpreted with caution. The impact of ABCP on delaying the development of new brain lesions requires further investigation.
